title: James Clerk Maxwell: A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I Source-Witnessed LaTeX Working Tranches
description:
Dedicated James Clerk Maxwell working-edition record for A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I. This version is prepared to add the pp.001-059 web/promo index closeout package while retaining the compact pp.001-059 source-verification checkpoint package, the IA master-image index/source-intake helper, and the earlier ledger-backed source-witnessed working tranches for book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and the main continuous run 111-267.

Status at a glance. This is not a complete Treatise edition and not a final critical edition. It should be cited as source-witnessed working tranches. The pp.001-059 closeout package contains cumulative pp.001-059 TeX/PDF/log, pp.058-059 closeout TeX/PDF/log, JP2 master leaves pp.001-059, p059 source/render images, figure crops, updated page-completion index, math index, notation-token register, source-verification logbook, notation heuristic diary, editorial choices CSV, structural audit, build-log diagnostics, checksums, and p59 visual closeout audit. It closes the previous p.059 register/index refresh note for this pp.001-059 tranche. The source-intake ZIP contains IA/DLI metadata, file manifests, candidate scan comparison, master-image indexes, row counts, URL probe results, and a README for reconstructing source-image provenance across the Maxwell Vol. I/II scan candidates. The packages are compact public checkpoints distilled from a much larger local verification tree.

Source-check ledgers and source witness images govern promoted range claims. OCR/XML material is used as a locator/witness layer, not as textual authority. The current pp.001-059 TeX/PDF is a verified working checkpoint; readers should use the included page log and math/token ledgers for audit and continuation. The next continuation point is printed p.060 / IA leaf 98.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

These supplement ZIPs do not extend promoted TeX coverage and OCR/XML witnesses remain locator/provenance layers only; decide at upload time whether the large source supplements belong on this Maxwell satellite or the main raw/provenance landing record. Not a complete Treatise edition or certified critical edition; read as source-witnessed working tranches. Continue at printed p080 / IA leaf 118.
